description: This file defines the VmTraces class, which contains information about processes and threads involved in Android bug report ANRs, including methods for retrieving process and thread snapshots.

classes.name: VmTraces
classes.description: Contains the information about any ANRs that happened in this bugreport, including lists of processes and methods to access specific process and thread snapshots.

methods.name: getProcess
methods.description: Returns the ProcessSnapshot for the given PID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getThread
methods.description: Returns the ThreadSnapshot for the given process PID and thread name, or null if not found.
